summary_1line: Victor learns his brother William was murdered, returns to Geneva, sees the Creature during a storm, and realizes it likely committed the crime while Justine is accused.

image_candidates.scene_text: During a violent lightning storm near Geneva, a flash reveals the gigantic, grotesque figure of the Creature climbing the rocks of Mont Salève.
Victor stands alone on a hill above the lake as lightning turns the water into a sheet of fire while thunder crashes over the Alps.
Elizabeth collapses beside William’s body at dawn, crying out that the missing miniature around his neck has caused his death.
